Nature.title: Injured locusts heal or are cannibalized depending on levels of a bacterial odour molecule
Nature.summary:
Nature, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03599-7

When migratory locusts are injured, an odorous chemical produced by bacteria living in or on their bodies activates the immune system, helping them to fight disease-causing agents. However, when a wound is large and the chemical becomes too concentrated, it attracts cannibalistic locusts.
